title: Representative comparison for the fixed Hom tower
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring R, and a scheme X. Use the completed coefficient sheaf $R_X$, the quotient sequence site with ring $\mathcal Q_X(n,U)=(R/\varpi^{n+1})_X(U)$, and ordinary unbounded derived categories as in [def-coef-tower-evaluation-pairing-constructions] and [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site]. Let S be any coherent derived-system calculus [def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data], and Q any strict cochain complex of quotient-sequence modules. Write $H(K)$ for the fixed functor coefPairingHom(S,Q), obtained by internal Hom from S.reduction(K) into Q and derived point sections with actual scalar restriction to R. For every $K\in D(R_X)$, any cochain complex P with $Q(P)\cong K$, any K-injective strict tower I of completed-module cochain complexes, and any isomorphism $Q(I)\cong\operatorname{Res}(Q)$, there is an R-linear isomorphism from H(K) to the localization of the strict tower of global Hom complexes $\operatorname{Hom}^\bullet_{R_X}(P,I_n)$. Its transitions are postcomposition by those of I, as constructed in coefPairingHomComplex. For each n there is a natural isomorphism of contravariant functors $\operatorname{ev}_nH\cong R\Gamma(X,R\mathcal Hom_{R_X}(-,\operatorname{Res}_nQ_n))$, the functor coefPairingIntegralHom(n,Q_n). P is arbitrary; no K-flatness condition is imposed on it, since the second representative is K-injective.
